description:
Downloads the content of a screen file: its HTML code or its screenshot.

**Instructions for Tool Call:**
*  Set `name` to the file's resource name from a screen's `html_code.name` or `screenshot.name` (returned by `get_screen`, `list_screens`, or the generation tools), e.g. `projects/4044680601076201931/files/ea26dc974c014bf28342b805ed0b7cfc`.
*  Use this tool instead of fetching `download_url` directly: those URLs require credentials and return a JSON wrapper rather than the file.

**Output:**
*  `html` holds the raw HTML for HTML files.
*  `image` holds the image bytes (base64-encoded in JSON) for images, with `image_metadata` (`mime_type`, `width`, `height`).

name.description: Required. The resource name of the file to download, as returned in a screen's `html_code.name` or `screenshot.name`. Format: `projects/{project}/files/{file}` Example: `projects/4044680601076201931/files/ea26dc974c014bf28342b805ed0b7cfc`

name: download_file

ImageMetadata.description: The metadata of an image file.

mimeType.description: The IANA media type of the image, for example "image/png".

html.description: The raw HTML code for HTML files. Only one of this field or image should be set.

image.description: The binary data for image files. Only one of this field or html should be set.

imageMetadata.description: The metadata of the image. Only set for image files.
